entries.title: II Chronicles 9:1
segments:
Sheba; supposed to have been a country of southern Arabia bordering on the Red sea. 
 
Those who know the value of true wisdom will seek to obtain it; and one means of this is, familiar conversation with those who possess it.  He that walketh with wise men shall be wise.

entries.title: II Chronicles 9:8
segments: All true wisdom comes from God, and habitual communion with him is the best means of obtaining it.

entries.title: II Chronicles 9:12
segments: A truly wise man will delight not only in receiving, but in imparting knowledge; and by doing it will become a benefactor to those around him.

entries.title: II Chronicles 9:20
segments: Silver and gold are a blessing or a curse according to the use that is made of them.  A wise man, therefore, will not be so anxious to obtain more, as he will be to use what he has to the glory of the Giver.

entries.title: II Chronicles 9:21
segments: The king's ships went to Tarshish; see note to

entries.title: II Chronicles 9:29
segments: Book of Nathan--of Ahijah--of Iddo; books of Jewish history, not now extant.
